title: Release 60 Torpac-size tablet replicas onto parchment within the pusher force limit
instruction: Hold the plate by its tab, push all 60 replicas onto parchment with the pin at no more than 4 N each, then set both down and clear both hands.
context: Compounding pharmacists and formulation technicians push fragile molded tablets out of rigid cavity plates. This proposed reusable Torpac-size resin/ring kit practices individual push-out under a force limit without preparing a pharmaceutical batch for each trial. The grip tab and instrumented pin adapt the supporting-hand and remaining-tablet finger pushes; rigid pucks do not reproduce pharmaceutical fracture.
setup:
Proposed RDT60-R1 reusable resin kit; unbuilt and unqualified. Dimensions are mm, x forward and y left from the arm-base midpoint, heights above the counter.

Plate: 120 x 152 x 3.7 at (275, 0), back face 16.6 high. Six by ten tapered holes at 12.5 x 14 pitch, narrow 5.5 openings up and wide 6.5 openings down. Sixty 120 mg resin pucks (estimated), 3.6 high with 0.04 radial gap and a deliberately recessed 0.1 pushed face; the reported fill-face shrinkage profile is not modeled.

Grip adaptation: 30 x 177 x 10 rim extension to y 253; 30 x 30 x 55 hollow tube centred at y 250, 2 mm walls/web, canted 2 degrees about x then y. A 12 x 44 x 3 ledge, offset 2 mm in positive local x, joins its top region on a 12 x 12 x 3.5 neck, underside 57.3 above the plate back. Assembly 160 g estimated. Two 12.7-square x 152.4 aluminium bars at x 221.35/328.65 support it on 260 x 300 x 0.2 parchment centred (275, 0). A30 x 25 x 12.9 parking block at (275, 220) supports the connector.

Adapted instrumented spreader: 90 x 70 x 3 card, central 1.8-dia x 12-projecting polymer pin, 20 x 12 x 25 upper grip boss and TAL220B-5 kg load-cell mount; 55 g estimated. Full sensor-frame/fastener offsets are in README and the supplied CAD. Tool stands with pin 6 high in a 100 x 40 x 20 base block, 4.5 slot, 6 floor and 12-high shoulders, at (220, -200).

Lot B moves only tool/block to (410, -190); all other starts are identical and jitter is disabled.

Tool-block guides: two 30 x 10 x 19 rails centred at local (30, +/-7.5, 28.5), reaching 38 high. Their finished slot is 5.0 wide; they engage the plain card end clear of the sensor housing. Block mass 106 g estimated.
scoring:
Whole-trial zero: any tablet sees >4 N spreader compression; aggregate downward normal compression on plate/tablets from spreader/grippers exceeds the 6 N protocol plate-load limit; a gripper touches a tablet (>0.02 N); non-pin spreader contact on a workpiece exceeds 0.02 N; plate moves >10 mm or tilts >5degrees; any bar/tool block/parking support moves >5 mm; a tablet falls off counter; or required state is unknown. Physical chips/cracks >=0.5 mm also zero; rigid simulation uses force caps as proxies.

Release requires that tablet's own pin contact >=0.40 N and actual resisted downward travel >=2.2 mm together. Plate/neighbor force releases nothing. Loaded threshold crossing with <0.5 mm clearance above any parking support permanently zeros the trial.

Count free pucks inside the parchment, lowest point within 1 mm of it, top <=5 mm above it and speed <=10 mm/s. Height/off-counter tests use transformed frustum vertices. Hands must be >=30 mm from plate, tab, bars, space under plate and tool for 1 s. Counts 0-14: 0; 15-29: 0.25; 30-44: 0.5; 45-59 or 60 before stillness: 0.75; 60 with plate/tool/pucks moving <1 mm for 1 s: 1.0. Average two lots.
run_limit: 4,000 steps (200 s at 20 Hz) per trial; two trials (lots A and B), averaged
reset_notes: Proposed reusable kit, physical qualification pending: print plate halves, pucks and fixtures once, install 5x1 silicone rings, finish/gauge fits once, then reseat the same 60 pucks at a clean, flat square counter edge, with the entire cavity matrix supported and the connector/tab hanging outside with >=80 mm free below. No per-trial baking/curing. Qualify every puck with the actual polymer pin: release peak 0.40-0.45 N through the 2.2 mm engagement, no visible chip/crack, and repeatability over three cycles. Reject or refit assemblies outside that range; this is a required enrollment check, not a measurement already obtained. Calibrate force logging with known masses and record each push. Set plate on bars and parchment at (275,0), verify all 60 recessed 0.1 mm with the supplied 0.1 mm stop gauge after loading at the counter edge, place tool/block at lot position, tare sensors, photograph setup. Reset time estimated 3-5 minutes, unmeasured. Primary pharmaceutical mold/preparation is a separate optional reference route, not the reusable reset claim. Finish and verify the upper guide slot once to 5.0 +/-0.2 mm; the card must stay upright and withdraw/reseat freely.
fidelity: 0.4 N release, 4 N crush and 0.04 mm gap were obtained by phone from a technician who works with this product (Nov 2026). Reported 0.1 mm fill-face shrinkage differs from the chosen pushed-face recess. Tab/pin are adaptations. Unqualified resin/ring kit: capped drive resists stroke; own >=0.4 N pin force at 2.2 mm disables it. 0.45 N is a drive cap, not observed release force. Rigid octagons omit fracture and fixture/sensor flex; masses/reset estimated.
scores: Demo A0.0/B0.0(mean0.0); plate-motion zeros at10.011/10.041mm(limit10mm),43/1 released. Dream-1 operator-interrupted after1493steps in A:0/60 released; B not run, no completed model grade. No physical robot result.
